content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Sessions ## slug: create-event-sessions-unpublished ## seoTitle: Sessions ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Warning) (**Important Limitation**) Discount Codes are not supported for Sessions. ::: Add {{variable.Object_Session}}s to an {{variable.Object_Event}} for breakouts, presentations, discussions, or other activities. ## Configure Sessions **Limitation:** {{variable.Object_Session}}s cannot be made mandatory out of the box. If you want to make {{variable.Object_Session}}s mandatory, please [see these steps](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/event-use-cases){target=`_blank`} for creating a flow. :::(Info) (Session Page Layout Update) The following sections and fields are now on the out-of-the-box Session object page layout. * Details Section * Post Session Questions * Webinar Information Section (new) * Webinar/Meeting Account * Webinar/Meeting ID * Webinar/Meeting Password * Webinar/Meeting URL ::: 1. From the {{variable.Object_Event}} record, navigate to the Sessions {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} and click {{variable.button_new}}. ![Configure Sessions 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Configure%20Sessions%201.png){height="" width=""} 2. Enter the {{variable.Field_Session_SessionName}}. :::(Warning) (**Session Name vs Display Name**) The {{variable.Field_ETSession_DisplayName}} field on Sessions overrides the {{variable.Field_Session_SessionName}} field on the front end. ::: 3. Add {{variable.Object_Session}} details such as, * {{variable.Field_Session_Description}} * {{variable.Field_Session_ImageURL}} * {{variable.Field_Session_AltTextVisualImp}} - This field is required if the {{variable.Field_Session_ImageURL}} has a value. * {{variable.Field_Session_Location}} * {{variable.Field_Session_StartDate}} * {{variable.Field_Session_StartTime}} * {{variable.Field_Session_EndDate}} * {{variable.Field_Session_EndTime}} NOTE: The {{variable.Object_Session}}’s {{variable.Field_Session_StartDateTime}} and {{variable.Field_Session_EndDateTime}} fields are not included on the {{variable.Object_Session}}’s page layout out of the box. They standardize calculations and display the {{variable.Object_Session}}’s start and end dates/times from the perspective of the time zone set on the authorized user’s profile instead of the time zone set on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. 4. To limit the number of people that can register and attend a {{variable.Object_Session}}, enter an amount in the {{variable.Field_Session_QuantityAvailabl}} The {{variable.Field_Session_QuantityRemainin}} is a formula field that will automatically update. Formula: {{variable.Field_Session_QuantityRemainin}} = {{variable.Field_Session_QuantityAvailabl}} - {{variable.Field_Session_Registered}} :::(Warning) (**Session Status Functionality**) * If a Session’s {{variable.Field_ETSession_Status}} is set to “Active” or is left blank, the Session will be displayed on the Event’s landing page. * If a Session’s {{variable.Field_ETSession_Status}} is set to any other value, the Session will not be displayed on the Event’s landing page. ::: ### Sorting Sessions {{snippet.EV_Sessions_SortingSessions}} ### Sold Out When {{variable.Field_Session_WaitlistEnabled}} is not checked and {{variable.Field_Session_QuantityRemainin}} = "0", the {{variable.Object_Session}} will be sold out. ### Waitlisted When {{variable.Field_Session_WaitlistEnabled}} is enabled and {{variable.Field_Session_QuantityRemainin}} = "0", additional {{variable.Object_Session}} registrants will have a {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_WaitPendi}} status and be added to the waitlist. ![Configure Sessions 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Configure%20Sessions%202.png){height="" width=""} ### Hide on Event Page The {{variable.Field_Session_HideOnEventPage}} checkbox allows users to hide the {{variable.Object_Session}} from the {{variable.Object_Event}}'s {{variable.Object_Session}} tab. As a result the {{variable.Object_Session}} will be invisible to the public. To prevent that from occuring, the following needs to occur: * The {{variable.Object_Session}} belongs to a specific track that is associated with an {{variable.AttendeeLink}} invitation. * The {{variable.Object_Session}} is pre-registered to an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} in the {{variable.AttendeeLink}} invitation. ![Configure Sessions 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Configure%20Sessions%203.jpeg){height="" width=""} 5. Once saved, view your newly created {{variable.Object_Session}} on the {{variable.Object_Event}} page. ![Configure Sessions 4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Configure%20Sessions%204.png){height="" width=""} ### Visibility To show the {{variable.Object_Session}}s on the {{variable.Object_Event}}, navigate to the [{{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/event-settings-1#tab-visibility-and-labels){target=`_blank`} and update the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Sessions}} field to "Always". Make sure that the {{variable.Object_Session}}'s {{variable.Field_Session_HideOnEventPage}} field is unchecked. ![Sessions](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Sessions.png){height="" width=""} If you only want {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s to see {{variable.Object_Session}}s on their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} and not on the {{variable.Object_Event}} registration page, complete the following steps. * Relate a {{variable.Object_Session}} to an {{variable.Object_EventItem}}, creating an {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}}. * Update the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}}’ Tab Visibility setting for {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Sessions}} to “Post Registration.” The {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}}s will now appear in an {{variable.Object_Attendee}}’s {{variable.AttendeeLink}}. ### Add Session to Calendar Complete the following steps to add a specific {{variable.Object_Session}} to a calendar from the {{variable.Object_Event}}'s webpage. 1. Go to the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s webpage. 2. Click the Sessions tab. 3. Click a {{variable.Field_Session_SessionName}}. 4. Click {{variable.Button_AddtoCalendar}}. 5. Select the calendar type. ![Session_Add%20to%20Calendar](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Session_Add%20to%20Calendar.png){height="" width=""} ### Data Dictionary and Session Counts {{snippet.Checkout_DataDictionaryCounts1}} #### Create a Data Dictionary Group {{snippet.Checkout_DataDictionaryCounts2}} #### Create Data Dictionary Entries {{snippet.Checkout_DataDictionaryCounts3}} ## Associate a Session with an Event Item Session After creating a new {{variable.Object_Session}}, you need to create and associate the new {{variable.Object_Session}} with the {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}}. 1. On the newly created {{variable.Object_Session}}’s record, locate the {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}}'s {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}}. 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Select an {{variable.Object_EventItem}} in the {{variable.Field_EventItemSession_EvenIte}} field. 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![New Event Item Session.png](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/New%20Event%20Item%20Session.png){height="" width=""} On the {{variable.Object_Event}} record, click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}}. The {{variable.Object_Session}} will now appear on the {{variable.Object_Event}}'s registration page. ## Relate a Session and an Event Item to an Event Item Session An {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Object_Session}} and {{variable.Object_EventItem}} must be related to an {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} record so the {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} can be included in the {{variable.AttendeeLink}} and checkout process. Once you have created {{variable.Object_Session}}s for your {{variable.Object_Event}}, complete the following steps. 1. Open the relevant {{variable.Object_Session}} record and locate the {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}}’s {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}}. 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. In the {{variable.Field_EventItemSession_EvenIte}} field, select the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} you want to attach the {{variable.Object_Session}} to. 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. You can also perform the process from an {{variable.Object_EventItem}} record. 1. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}}'s {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}}. 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. In the {{variable.Field_EventItemSession_Session}} field, select the {{variable.Object_Session}} you want to attach the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} to. 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. After selecting an {{variable.Object_EventItem}} and entering their information during checkout, Attendees will see a **Review Sessions** button. They can then select an {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} before completing the registration process. ## Overlapping Sessions :::(Warning) (Please Be Aware) Overlapping {{variable.Object_Session}} validation only occurs on the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage’s {{variable.Object_Session}} selection page during checkout, the {{variable.Object_Event}} page, and the {{variable.AttendeeLink}}. Validation will not happen through other means of {{variable.Object_Session}} registration, such as manually adding {{variable.Object_Session}}s in the {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} UI. ::: Event Organizers can now prevent {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s from registering for overlapping {{variable.Object_Session}}s. This functionality allows for a more organized and manageable event schedule and ensures that an event's resources like {{variable.Object_Session}} seats and event spaces are used effectively. The following event types are just a few examples where you can use the overlapping {{variable.Object_Session}}s feature. * **Large-scale events & conferences:** * Ensure that {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s do not book {{variable.Object_Session}}s that occur simultaneously, improving schedule management. * **Classes, workshops & training:** * Prevent time conflicts in {{variable.Object_Session}} attendance for classes or workshop {{variable.Object_Session}}s. * Avoid overlapping training {{variable.Object_Session}}s to ensure employees can attend all required training without conflicts. ### Prevent Session Overlapping Field The {{variable.Field_EV_PreventSessionOverlap}} checkbox was added to the {{variable.Object_Event}} object to prevent {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s from registering for overlapping {{variable.Object_Session}}s. * Field Label: {{variable.Field_EV_PreventSessionOverlap}} * API Name: conference360__Prevent_Session_Overlapping__c * Data Type: Checkbox * Help Text: If this is checked, registration for overlapping Sessions is not available to an Attendee. * Default Value: False (unchecked) When checked, Attendees cannot register for overlapping Sessions. If {{variable.Field_EV_PreventSessionOverlap}} = “True” (checked), {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s cannot register for overlapping {{variable.Object_Session}}s. When the field is enabled, the following will occur. * During checkout, the **Add All** button will not be visible on the Session Registration page. * The **Add** button next to the {{variable.Object_Session}} will be grayed out if an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} tries to select a {{variable.Object_Session}} that overlaps with a {{variable.Object_Session}} already in their cart. #### Limitations * This only applies to {{variable.Object_Session}}s within the same {{variable.Object_Event}}. It does not apply to overlapping {{variable.Object_Session}}s across different {{variable.Object_Event}}s. * The overlapping {{variable.Object_Session}} validation occurs only on the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}-facing {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventPageURL}}. There is no validation on the {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} side. This allows Event Organizers to book overlapping time slots when registering {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s for {{variable.Object_Session}}s in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. #### Update the Event Page Layout If the {{variable.Field_EV_PreventSessionOverlap}} field is not on the {{variable.Object_Event}} object’s page layout, follow the steps below to add it. 1. Go to Setup. 2. Click the Object Manager tab. 3. In the Quick Find box, enter and click “Event” (conference360__Event__c). 4. Click the Page Layouts tab. 5. Click Event Layout. 6. Enter “Prevent Session Overlapping” in the Quick Find box. 7. Drag and drop the {{variable.Field_EV_PreventSessionOverlap}} field onto the page layout. 8. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![Event Record_PreventOverlappingSession Field](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Event%20Record_PreventOverlappingSession%20Field.png){height="" width=""} ### Examples The following examples show how using the {{variable.Field_EV_PreventSessionOverlap}} field can prevent {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s from registering for overlapping {{variable.Object_Session}}s. #### Event 1 * Event Date: March 3 * Event Item 2 has the following {{variable.Object_Session}}s. * Session C: 9:00 am – 10:00 am * Session D: 9:00 am – 10:00 am * Registration Process * Attendee 2 selects Event Item 2 with Session C and Session D. * Result: Fail – Attendee 2 cannot complete the registration process because the {{variable.Object_Session}} times overlap. #### Event 2 * Event Date: March 3 * Event Items * Event Item 5 has the following {{variable.Object_Session}}. * Session G: 9:00 am – 10:00 am * Event Item 6 has the following {{variable.Object_Session}}. * Session H: 9:00 am – 10:00 am * Registration process: * Attendee 6 selects Event Item 5 with Session G. * Attendee 6 selects Event Item 6 with Session H. * Result: Fail - Registration failed because the {{variable.Object_Session}}s overlapped. The {{variable.Object_Session}}s are related to different Event Items, but the user used the same data for each {{variable.Object_Attendee}}. ## Featured Sessions If you would like to bring a few featured {{variable.Object_Session}}s to the top of the page, the featured {{variable.Object_Session}} feature is just what you need! ### Set Up (For Admins) 1. Open the Object Manager. 2. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_Session}} object. 3. Click **Page Layouts** and **Session Layout**. 4. Add the {{variable.Field_Session_FeatureSession}} checkbox field to the page layout. **NOTE:** If end-users need access to this and they aren't associated to a managed Blackthorn Events permission set, please add this field to their profile/custom permission set. ### Test (For Event Managers) If you would like to feature {{variable.Object_Session}}s at the top of the {{variable.Object_Session}} tab in a carousel format, check the {{variable.Field_Session_FeatureSession}} checkbox field. * If you add multiple featured {{variable.Object_Session}}s, they will scroll through the featured session box every 10 seconds. * Example: There are 3 featured {{variable.Object_Session}}s added to this {{variable.Object_Event}}. There are 2 non-featured {{variable.Object_Session}}s. Featured {{variable.Object_Session}}s 1, 2, and 3 will scroll through the top margin. ![Featured Sessions](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Featured%20Sessions.png){height="" width=""} ## Learn More About {{variable.Object_Session}} Related Items * Add {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s to {{variable.Object_Session}}s [here](/v1/docs/session-registration). * Add {{variable.Object_Track}}s to {{variable.Object_Session}}s [here](/v1/docs/event-tracking). * Add {{variable.Object_Staff}} to {{variable.Object_Session}}s [here](/v1/docs/event-staff#section-define-staff-at-the-session-level).
